title: Thank you for joining us at our DQ fundraiser!

title: August 9 Chicago Food Packing Event
excerpt: We packed 1200+ sandwiches and 650 brown bags at our August food packing event! Special shoutout to National India Hub for hosting us and their partnership.

title: June 14 Chicago Food Packing Event
excerpt: We packed 1250+ sandwiches and 650 brown bags at our June food packing event! Thanks for joining hand to help feed the needy.

title: SBF Junior Board meets with IL State Representative Nabeela Syed
